description.en:
G2 is AgiBot's embodied-intelligence robot for industrial manipulation and interactive work. Its product presentation emphasizes force-controlled operation and fine assembly, combining physical task execution with a perception and learning system intended to support deployment in real working environments. AgiBot identifies Genie RL as part of the platform's approach to developing and deploying task capabilities.

G2 also includes an interaction layer with speech, gestures, expressions and attention to multiple people. These functions support communication around a work task rather than limiting the robot to isolated motion sequences. The manufacturer lists IP42 protection; task precision and performance claims depend on the specific application, tooling and operating conditions.

specs.label: Force control
specs.conditions: G2 manufacturer describes high-precision force-controlled work; no independently measured error bound supplied.
